headline: The S&P 500 had its worst weekly drop since the pandemic
summary: The S&P 500 had its worst weekly drop since the pandemic, while Wall Street's fear index closed at its highest level since April 7, 2025.
why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark for large US equities, and sharp weekly declines affect portfolio values and risk appetite across global markets.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The index recorded its worst weekly decline since the pandemic, as reported.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The sell-off pushed the Wall Street fear index to its highest close since April 2025, signalling heightened investor anxiety.
original_headline: El S&P 500 tuvo su peor caída semanal desde la pandemia
